## Verified professional scope

Zachary designs and builds full-stack applications, internal tools, AI-assisted workflows, databases, APIs, OAuth integrations, secure operational systems, deployment pipelines, and technical documentation around real business requirements.

His selected work includes the CSI CRM and Operations Platform, an AI Business Operating System, AI-assisted document processing, business automation connectors, TikTok analytics readiness, and the Recall secure clipboard workspace.

At CSI: Clean Scene Investigators, Zachary's role includes co-ownership, financial leadership, operational systems, workflow architecture, and technical systems ownership. CSI is a DFW and North Texas specialty cleanup company focused on crime scene, trauma, biohazard, unattended death, hoarding, odor, and vehicle biohazard cleanup.
